rules.statement: A decree-holder may sue for the balance of a debt even after an agreement to settle all claims, provided that the agreement does not supersede the original decree and the decree-holder has taken no steps by way of execution until after the agreement.
rules.supporting_quote: As to the first of these grounds, the time necessarily occupied in realizing the assigned securities, in my opinion, explains the delay consistently with the continuance in force of the decree.
